code='''def transform(grid):
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] and v != 0 for v in row))
    upper = grid[:divider]
    lower = grid[divider+1:]
    colors = {v for row in upper for v in row if v not in (0, 5)}
    # Select the rightmost colored object in the upper panel.
    color = max(colors, key=lambda c: max(j for row in upper for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c))
    def crop(rows, color):
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(rows) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        return [[color if rows[r][c] == color else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)], c0
    top, _ = crop(upper, color)
    bottom_color = next(v for row in lower for v in row if v)
    bottom, left = crop(lower, bottom_color)
    out = [[0] * len(grid[0]) for _ in range(9)]
    def paste(shape, y, x):
        for i, row in enumerate(shape):
            for j, value in enumerate(row):
                if value:
                    out[y+i][x+j] = value
    # The lower figure is lifted six rows; the selected figure is stacked directly above it.
    paste(top, len(bottom)+1, left)
    paste(bottom, len(bottom)+1-len(bottom), left)
    return out
'''
